svg.title: Lieutenant Fizz for DOS
svg.desc: Lieutenant Fizz: Episode 1, The Cocoa Caper, for DOS. A dark banner with a pixel-art CRT monitor showing the game's title screen — white lettering with a red edge over purple hills, a yellow menu plate and a bobbing soda can — beside the project name and a DOS prompt running FIZZ.EXE.
